grades_model_estimate: Model estimate · only teachers see this
grades_fail_tip: From the same forecast as the likely band: how often its tested errors would put the final grade below {pass}. Trained on simulated school years ({version}).
grades_heading: Where the final grade is heading
grades_likely_tip: “Likely” is a model estimate: in testing, 8 in 10 final grades landed in a range like this. “Still possible” means 4s or 10s on everything still open.
grades_possible_tip: “Still possible” means 4s or 10s on everything still open: the trimesters still to come, the rest of this one and any part without a mark yet.
grades_made_up: How the grade is made up
grades_over_year_tip: The line is your average after each day with a new mark; the pale dots are the single marks.
rule2_after: . Averages round up only from .6: 4.6 becomes a 5 (pass), 4.5 becomes a 4 (fail).
rule3_after: . Mitarbeit and Schularbeit are averaged per trimester first, and every trimester counts the same. A part that has not been graded yet is left out rather than counted as zero.
rule4: “Still open” means the trimesters still to come, the rest of the current one (at about the pace so far) and any part without a mark yet. “Already safe” means even 4s on all of that would pass.
rule5: The darker “likely” band is an estimate from a model, not a rule: it was tested on simulated school years, where 8 in 10 final grades landed inside it.
rule6: “Close to the line” means passing, but below {value}.
rule7: Class figures are averages only. You never see another student's marks.
